messages:
Olivia: Heads up 1: vendor OrionGrid sent invoice INV-2026-092 for $62,410 but theres no PO number on the PDF. Attaching scan to thread. Can AP freeze payment? /cc @Marcus @Priya

ap-bot: invoice INV-2026-092 uploaded to AP queue (invoices/2026/INV-2026-092.pdf). Auto-pay disabled: false

Marcus: AP 1: I can flip the auto-pay off if you confirm hold. Also need GL code and cost center. If invoice > $50k it needs PO or exec sign-off per policy.

Priya: This charge is for Reserved Dedicated runtime (March burst). We had PO PO-OR-3421 for $50,000, approved by Devin, but vendor billed additional metered usage.

Devin: Confirmed PO-OR-3421 exists for committed reservation. Contract section 4.2 allows metered billing for excess usage. But vendor usually references PO on invoice.

Olivia: Thanks. I'll ask OrionGrid to either: 1) reissue two invoices (PO-OR-3421 for $50k with PO reference + separate invoice for $12,410 overage) or 2) annotate current invoice with PO-OR-3421 and clarify contract clause.

Marcus: Good plan. In the meantime I placed a manual hold (ap_flag: HOLD_NO_PAY). Ticket AP-6310 created to track.

Priya: If they split, AP can pay the PO-backed invoice immediately. For the overage we need a cost justification and approval from Devin or Finance lead. Devin, can you pre-approve up to $15k overage for this vendor this quarter?

Devin: I can approve up to $15k if Eng provides run logs and a short explanation. Please include contract excerpt showing metered billing. If vendor refuses to split, we escalate to Legal.

Olivia: Reached out to billing@oriongrid.ai asking for split or PO update. Message sent: "Please reissue or annotate INV-2026-092 to reference PO-OR-3421, or split into 50k PO invoice + $12,410 overage with itemized usage. We cannot process >$50k without PO or exec approval."

Legal: Looping in Legal in case vendor resists. If contract language supports their invoice we can authorize payment after approvals.

ap-bot: AP ticket AP-6310 updated: status=waiting_on_vendor. Reminder set for 3 business days.

Emilia: Eng can produce usage report and a quick note on why burst exceeded reservation. I'll attach logs when ready.

Marcus: Perfect. Once we have usage log + contract excerpt, Devin can sign off and AP will release PO-backed portion immediately. Leaving :eyes: reaction.

Olivia: Will update here with vendor reply. For now invoice remains on hold.
